hardening.scope: repository-local PCC runtime, GUI/provider layer, automatic onboarding/build-plan discovery and snapshot performance
hardening.validation: U4 regression matrix plus U5 mixed-component discovery/build, scan cache, snapshot, adapter pinning, release-target, unresolved-engine and control-plane protection tests

notes: U5 scans unfamiliar repositories and synthesizes transparent component-aware gate/build/test/run operations without executing them during install.
Mixed repositories expose unique per-component operations while semantic Build/Test/Quick operations compose all matching targets.
The GUI uses one cached project snapshot per refresh and adds a Build Plan view with components, defaults, warnings and unresolved tooling.
Generated adapters can be explicitly pinned but project-owned adapters are never overwritten.
Execution-control metadata is protected from generic root-drop project patches.
Machine-wide Vault, Ember hosting and full-drive orchestration remain outside this detached repository-local core.
Havenwild local GUI publisher calls the existing project PCC and never independently stages or pushes Git source.
C16R10 blocks generic ForgePY commit/push for Havenwild, reuses project-owned PCC publication, and retires generated index content only after canonical GREEN verification.

havenwildProjectIntegration.scope: Project PCC owns publication; explicit generated index retirement and source-snapshot strict staging
